name: Baatz Blueberry Farm
tagline: This Michigan blueberry farm has berries that ‘don’t exist anywhere else in the world’
description: Baatz Blueberry Farm is an agritourism farm in 900 Blueberry Lane, MI, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
